name: TMJ_Crop
description: Crop the temporomandibular joints of a CBCT.

scans.description: One CBCT (.nrrd, .nii.gz and the other formats ASO reads), or a folder of them for a batch.

output_dir.description: Where results are written. Per scan: `<scan>_R.nii.gz` and `<scan>_L.nii.gz` (the crops), `<scan>.json` (the report) and `<scan>_qc.png` (a quick view); only the sides asked for are written.

sides.description: Which joint to crop: `Left and Right`, `Left` or `Right`.
sides.label: Joints to crop

outputs.description: What to hand back beside the crops, in the oriented frame they were cut from. Oriented scan: the whole scan, as `<scan>_oriented.nii.gz`. Mandible segmentation: the mandible mask (AMASSS), as `<scan>_mandible.nii.gz`.
outputs.label: Extra outputs
outputs.note: Saved beside the crops, in the oriented frame. The crops, the report and the quick view are always written.

option_help.Oriented scan: The whole scan in the Frankfurt horizontal frame the crops were cut from, as <scan>_oriented.nii.gz.
option_help.Mandible segmentation: The mandible mask (AMASSS) in that same frame, as <scan>_mandible.nii.gz.

scale_by.description: `none` keeps the box at 28.8 x 33.6 x 24.0 mm. With `mandible-volume` the box follows the cube root of the mandible volume, the voxel count staying the same.

scale.description: A fixed scale factor, overriding `scale_by`; 0 means not given. Useful to reuse one patient's first time point for the next.
